verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say its getting-started flow covers managing risks and that the SOC 2 Launchpad lets users 'action policies, risks, and evidence', so a risk-management capability exists in-platform. Beyond that the evidence is a bare 'Continuous Risk Monitoring' page title. The documented risk scoring applies to AI systems, a different module, so it is not credited here as a general risk register. Missing for 10: documented risk scoring for the register, treatment plans, risk owners, recurring review cycles, risk-to-control mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: configure governance, build a security programme, and manage risks for complete compliance readiness
